request_payload.title: Loss of CDKL5 disrupts kinome profile and event-related potentials leading to autistic-like phenotypes in mice.

mentions.sentence: Mutations in the X-linked cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) gene have been identified in neurodevelopmental disorders including atypical Rett syndrome (RTT), autism spectrum disorders (ASDs), and early infantile epileptic encephalopathy.
